text: Seismic loads for all electrical equipment, anchorage, cable supports and battery racks follow TBDY 2018 with the PGA of DP-CASE-0002 and site class of DP-OWNR-0048. Equipment shall be qualified by type test or analysis per IEC 60068-3-3 or IEEE 344 for the required response spectrum, and shall keep its function (no trip, no loss of supply) after the design earthquake.
